records.idCN: 炸鸡店/NPC/克里斯皮/大头贴机打招呼2
records.words: The Seals' Photo Booth is the \nlatest trend. No harm \ntaking a few photos, right?
Welcome to Seal's Tea Shop! \nWhat do you feel like drinking?
Can I interest you in trying our \nnew beverages? The reviews have been great so far!
Could you repeat more loudly what you're looking for? We have nothing \nbut the best music and drinks here!
How about some sparkling water? Imagine the bubbles and rock 'n' roll music making your soul \nburst!
Shouldn't we go find work? The crew's finances have become tight again.
Yeah, Conductor is also worried.
How about hunting some game to sell?
This is a Bonfire City, so no one would buy game of an unknown origin...
Besides, if we encounter a Morphic Field Pollution check, your precious game might be confiscated for inspection.
What should we do then — Ah, over there! The notice board near the platform!
...A recruitment poster for the City Defense Force? If we join up with them, we'll definitely have to mingle in the crowd. Isn't that what you fear the most?
If you're cool with it, I'm fine. Maybe if we keep working like this, I'll really be able to bring you back.
N-No. I really don't want to be with so many people... Hey, over there! Let's go see if the BCRL Agency has any missions!
Back when I was still living at home, my dad would sometimes dry the herbs I gathered and make tea with them. That was slightly more bitter but the fragrance was just as nice.
Sorry! Here, have some.
You gave me a scare... You should've told me about this earlier!
Do you want some tea, Eliot? I just brewed some.
Ah, it's fine today. It's not black tea, just common herbal tea with a calming effect.
Well, when you find those herbs again, let's make that kind of tea together!
But I remember... tea gives you insomnia, right? You stayed up too late the other time after drinking tea and almost missed the shift change. Fran had to search three carriages to find you.
Oh yeah! What's the flavor today? Black tea? The one I had last time was delicious!
...It's fragrant. Not too bitter...This is yummy too!
Although I don't know much about brewing tea, I can still try making simple herbal tea.
Awesome! It's a deal, Livia!
I've seen it before. Eliot is a marksman in bird shooting!
But, Eliot also cheats sometimes!
Well, in any case, my point is, Desiree is very good.
I'm not going to compete with you in shooting again. You're so accurate that it's almost like cheating!
Uhh... Is being too good considered cheating?
Ahahaha... Haha...
I'm not accusing you of cheating. It's just that you're really good at it! After all, I lack the ascension ability...
Desiree didn't cheat. She followed the rules we agreed on! Only one arrow allowed at a time, no pointed arrowheads, and the bowstring must be loosened. That's not cheating!
Huh?! When did I cheat?!
How could that be? Many people in the Empire make a living by hunting. Sometimes Cook even goes out to find food himself.
Hmm... It's basically dried meat and cooked meat... And Cook's favorite is grilled bird skewers.
...So people on the ground just bring back cooked food when they go hunting?
No, no. I bought this at the supermarket. But I got scared just now thinking you were going to say Cook wouldn't forgive me after I hunted its brethren...
Eh.
Are you holding... grilled chicken?
...Haha...This is, uh, the fruit of my labor today!
Huh?
So what does Cook usually eat? I see you feeding it something different every time.
Grilled bird skewers?! But isn't it a bird?!
Yeah, I don't quite understand either... Oh, it says, "Because it's delicious."
W-What an enigmatic bird...

records.words: Hehe... Watch! Hook this string here...
Haruka, the dish you made last time was delicious!
I don't think so. Have some confidence in your cooking skills. Haruka, your cooking is really delicious, and you make full use of the equipment on the train.
Did you learn a new recipe? From BOX?
...It's nothing special. I just tried a new recipe I learned.
Your cooking skills are impressive. I've heard everyone praise your cooking, and now that I've witnessed it myself, I completely agree.
Isn't it because there's no alternative available, so they're forced to eat it?
Yeah, I jotted the recipe down when I happened to hear it on the radio. It turned out surprisingly well. Perfect for supper.
Really... Thanks then. Fran, too...
Yeah, when it's my turn to cook next, I'll also prepare some dishes from outside to impress you, Haruka~
...That's not what I meant. But, go ahead if you feel like doing so.
Then you're pretty talented, eh? Being able to make different people united.
Did you see the new Team Mission Guidebook I put out?
I don't think it's a talent. Perhaps my experience with squabbling younger siblings back home taught me how to mediate between others?
Haha, come to think of it, they are actually quite similar in many ways indeed! Even the tendency to slack off and dislike going to school~
...You're definitely suited to be a leader.
Huh? I've always been the one leading the team.
Yeah, I saw it. There're updates on a few mission clauses, but the rest hasn't changed much. It shouldn't affect our duties.
Nah, I don't have such an intention. But, when it comes to frontline combat, I'm usually the one leading the team.
...As far as I know, there shouldn't be. Conductor issues the orders directly.
No, that's not what I'm asking... I'm just wondering if there's a similar manual on The Eternal.
Sorry, we weren't talking behind your back... We're just kind of curious about combat on The Eternal.

We're in similar situations then. Dorothy should still be in the B.C.R.L. officer's room writing appraisals. While Karen... was just led away by Shizuru for special training, after petering her for too long.
Oh, yeah. I just finalized... the results of Eliot and Desiree's shooting competition.
Hey, are you here to rest?
I thought everyone in Team Ratel was as reliable as Julian...
...I thought everyone on The Eternal was as reliable as Fran...
The two of them used all the empty cans and glass bottles on the whole train as targets... Those could've been recycled, but not anymore. Although it isn't a big loss, still... sigh.
Right. You too?
I don't know what to do, so I'm just resting here for a while.
Let's not discuss whether I'm reliable or not. Those two definitely cannot be relied on.
